<!-- Established by ADR-0006 (A8). Pattern transcribed from docs/IMPLEMENTATION_BACKLOG.md,
     where every SCI-N state opens with a "Refine <STATE> backlog" objective. -->

**Backlog ID:** `SCI<state>-001`

**State being refined:** `SCI-0` / `SCI-0.5` / `SCI-1` / `SCI-2` / `SCI-3` / `SCI-4` / `SCI-5`

**Prior-state outcomes this refinement is contingent on** (per `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PROTOCOL_SCIENTIFIC.md` §16 sequencing notes):

**Governing ADR(s), if any govern data or scope for this state** (e.g. `SCI0-001` depends on `ADR-0003` acceptance per its own contingency clause):

**Scope:** operational expansion of the backlog only — adds no new rule (`docs/IMPLEMENTATION_BACKLOG.md` §0/relationship-to-SI16 note).
